narrative:
Auglaize County has 31,952 registered voters, with 52.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 40.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 7.4%, a pronounced Republican lean of 32.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.5% of registrants.
